Because the sable commitment is timestamped in the atlas ledger, the ivory audit verifies the pair and a late swap fails the hash. The answer is committed as a 129 bit hash at open and revealed at close, and a reveal that does not match the commitment is void. The bill scales 20 fold, not the vote. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
